subject.title: Feature: Talk Mode Idle Timeout / Auto-Deactivation After Voice Wake

question: Should OpenClaw support an additive Talk idle-timeout setting for all Talk sessions, only Voice Wake-started Talk sessions, or defer this to a broader voice lifecycle design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public lifecycle and configuration behavior across Talk surfaces, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
options.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, bounds, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and macOS runtime.

options.title: Scope to Voice Wake sessions
options.body: Track activation source and auto-deactivate only sessions started from Voice Wake, leaving manually started Talk sessions unchanged.

options.title: Defer broader lifecycle design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers design a larger Talk and Voice Wake lifecycle policy that also covers realtime and mobile behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
recommendation.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, bounds, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and macOS runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on the Talk runtime/config/protocol files that define the public contract.
